title: Help with full portraits for rpg maker mz.

posts.author: Scion_of_the_Shadowlight
posts.body:
I was not sure where exactly catagory this belonged so i just put it here. I had made a character from the generator, then when i went to play test and view the equipment page, evidently it is supposed to show the character's portrait...so an error occurs saying that it cannot be found, then it dawned on me. Does the character generator seriously not give us the full-body portrait too??
P.S: yeah, it is a plugin that shows the full body portrait, which is why it broke, but i am still a little baffled that the generator does not give any full body png, anything that could help me with getting the character his full body or am I just making an impossible wish?

Scion_of_the_Shadowlight said:
then it dawned on me. Does the character generator seriously not give us the full-body portrait too??
Click to expand...
No. It gives you exactly what it shows on the screen. Face, map character and SV battler.
MZ comes with some busts of the default actors and people, and full-body artwork for the same in the dlc folder, but it doesn't generate either for anything from the generator.
If you want that artwork, you'll need to draw or commission it.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
Yes, it "seriously" doesn't. It would be almost impossible to make them look natural. You can get away with layering pieces paperdoll-style for small things, like the sprite or the face--but the larger the area in the image, the more places there are that it could be obvious that something isn't quite right. Furthermore, all the characters would be in exactly the same pose, and have exactly the same body type...it wouldn't be as good as you want it to be, not unless a
ton
of money and resources were poured into it. And even then, it still wouldn't be as good as you hope. Think of the difference between using a picrew/dress-up game for your character art, versus hiring an artist do custom work for you specifically.
You can use a placeholder temporarily, that will satisfy the requirements of the plugin and should let the game run correctly, but you'll have to source the final artwork yourself.

posts.body:

all the characters would be in exactly the same pose, and have exactly the same body type...you'll have to source the final artwork yourself.

To be fair, if one doesn't care about those issues, there
are
various anime or 3D character generators and paper doll software and stuff, if the ToU of those things allows you to use their output in another (commercial?) game.
But you'd likely have a hard time getting the clothing on those things to match what you chose in MZ's generator.

posts.author: Scion_of_the_Shadowlight
posts.body: Its not needed, i am just a little surprised, I had assumed that the base characters that came with the game where made by the generator, and therefore, i assumed that the generator would have portraits, like the base characters do.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Scion_of_the_Shadowlight said:
I had assumed that the base characters that came with the game where made by the generator
Click to expand...
No, nothing that comes in the default assets was made by the generator. In fact, most of the default characters and battlers can't be reproduced by the generator.
There are threads where people have picked apart the sprites to make generator parts out of the outfits from the default actors, but they're all custom-drawn sprites.
